viewing_check: Check timber (oak vs chestnut/walnut/pine), whether carving is applied or carved from solid (applied mouldings suggest later work), tool marks and nails (hand wrought vs machine), the lid hinges, any splits and replaced base or feet, and whether the gilt colour is old. Photograph the underside and the back.
